newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares seen weighed by dollar, poll.
newsitem.headline: French shares seen weighed by dollar, poll.

text.p: French shares were seen opening lower on Friday in a volatile but empty market on the back of an easier dollar, a drop on Wall Street and a new poll showing the smallest lead yet for France's centre-right coalition.
The dollar was down on intervention fears after statements by Japanese Finance ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara.
An Ipsos poll for Le Point on Thursday evening gave the centre-right only one seat more than the required majority for the upcoming May 25-June 1 election.
May futures were trading 19 points lower at 2,611.
The bourse was closed on Thursday for Ascension Day.
